card.name: Verbs in label instructions and overdose text
card.fires_on: Instruction or management words in drug-label directions, such as 'inquire' before asking about hypersensitivity history, and words in overdose or procedure sections. Also fires on single words like 'enhance', 'misuse' or '%' inside a longer clause.

modes.label: Ask about history
modes.description: The verb 'inquire' in a pre-treatment instruction about prior hypersensitivity.
modes.example: Prior to use,<< inquire>> regarding history of hypersensitivity to beta-l

modes.label: Overdose and management wording
modes.description: Words in overdose or post-placement sections that continue a clinical instruction.
modes.example: Hemodialysis does not significantly<< enhance>> clearance of rosuvastatin.

modes.label: Scattered clause words
modes.description: Single words or symbols in the middle of a clause, such as a, %, patient or should.

card.plain: It marks a word in the middle of a label instruction or overdose passage, where the next words are still to come.
